description: This file defines the ApplyLeaveController class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, responsible for handling leave application logic. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes various traits for authentication, date/time handling, and work schedule services. The preRender method prepares data related to work shifts and sets a Vue component for the leave application UI.

classes.name: ApplyLeaveController
classes.description: Controller handling the leave application process, extending Vue controller, integrating work schedule, auth, and date/time traits to prepare leave-related UI components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave application component with work shift times for rendering.
